notes:
### Signals in one pass, and the search index stops waiting cold

- **Signals runs shot detection first and decodes each clip once.** A
  640-clip wedding sat at "5 min remaining" for an hour and a half because
  Signals decoded every clip twice, one clip at a time, and found its shot
  boundaries fourth of six passes while the search index waited on them.
  Boundaries are now stored before the other passes start, the shot scan and
  the motion profile share one decode, and Signals works several clips in
  parallel (a quarter of the cores, at most four).
- **The search index keeps SigLIP loaded while it waits on Signals** instead
  of unloading and reloading it (eight reloads in one log), and the Queue
  tray says how much of the index's remaining time is spent waiting on
  Signals.
- **The watch-folder sentinel no longer rebuilds on every sidecar write.**
  It rebuilt 9,696 times in one session; now it rebuilds once, when a
  missing folder appears.
- **Mac build:** OpenCV's loader files inside the app get the Developer ID
  signature, so Gatekeeper accepts the notarized app.
